description: This file defines API declarations for managing DSLite configurations, including functions for getting and setting parameters, managing interface entries, and transaction controls within the DSLite object.

methods.name: DSLite_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the DSLite object.

methods.name: DSLite_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the DSLite object.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Gets the number of interface setting entries.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interface setting entry by index.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new interface setting entry.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an existing interface setting entry.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value for an interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_Validate
methods.description: Validates the interface setting parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the interface setting.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting4_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back changes to the interface setting.
